column1: # The robot markers of RULES.md rule 2, machine-readable for the wording checker
# (`scripts/wording_lint.py`). This is the shared list: every project consumes it,
# and a project pipeline wraps the checker where useful (socrates:
# `projects/kubs_dt/pipeline.py lint`). One copy lives here; project repos do not
# Columns, tab-separated: level <TAB> pattern <TAB> fix <TAB> exception (optional).
# level: flag = the lint fails on a hit; warn = reported only.
# The pattern is a Python regex, matched case-insensitively, one hit per line.
# A quoted excerpt is declared by `<!-- verbatim -->` ... `<!-- end verbatim -->`
# and its lines are skipped whole: the source's text is not the writer's.
# The list is the checkable subset by design: three-item runs, embedded clauses,
# headings over one sentence and colon-field blocks stay a writer's pass.

column1: # Contrast frames (RULES.md rule 2, class 1): every way a sentence defines a claim by
# the alternative it rejects. Warn in prose; the note gate fails them in a summary
# line and a section's first sentence (rows whose fix starts "contrast frame").

column3: contrast frame: "X, not Y" - say what is true and what you do
contrast frame: "not X but Y" - state Y on its own
contrast frame: "it is not X, it is Y" - state Y on its own

column2: \b(?:rather than|instead of|in place of|as opposed to)\b
column3: contrast frame: substitution ("rather than", "instead of") - name the one you take
contrast frame: "not just X" - say the whole thing once
contrast frame: a contrast marker ("unlike", "whereas") - state each fact on its own
contrast frame: "X versus Y" - state the call and its reason
contrast frame: "less X than Y", "the point is not X" - state Y
contrast frame: an absence set beside the claim - state what you have
contrast frame: "never X, always Y" - state Y

column1: # Everyday contrast forms: concession, a concessive turn, a scalar extreme, counter-expectation,
# proof by an event, effort set against its outcome, and a correction marker.

column3: contrast frame: concession ("even though", "although", "despite") - state each fact on its own
contrast frame: a concessive turn ("yet", "even so", "but still") - state the second fact plainly

column2: \b(?:not even|let alone|much less|hardly|barely|only just|not so much)\b
column3: contrast frame: a scalar extreme ("not even", "let alone", "barely") - give the number

column2: \b(?:surprisingly|unexpectedly|counterintuitively|ironically|paradoxically|strikingly|contrary to|against (?:all )?expectations?|(?:it )?turns out)\b|\bthan (?:you|one|we|most people)(?:'d| might| would)? (?:expect|think|assume)\b|\b(?:more|less|higher|lower) than expected\b
column3: contrast frame: counter-expectation ("surprisingly high", "it turns out") - state the figure and what it means for you
contrast frame: proof by an event ("as the March booking showed") - state the fact with its date

column2: \b(?:despite|for all|in spite of)\s+(?:your|all your|all the|his|her|their|our)\s+(?:\w+\s+){0,2}(?:effort|efforts|work|time|research|trying|planning)\b|\bonly to\b|\bin vain\b|\bfor nothing\b|\beven after\b
column3: contrast frame: effort set against its outcome ("despite your effort", "only to") - state the outcome and your next step

column2: \b(?:if anything|in fact|in reality|actually)\b|\bthe real (?:\w+ )?(?:question|issue|point|cost|problem|reason)\b|\bwhat (?:really|actually) matters\b|\bthe (?:catch|thing|twist|irony) is\b|\bat least\b(?!\s+(?:\d|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|half|a|an)\b)
column3: contrast frame: a correction marker ("actually", "in fact", "the catch is", "at least") - state the fact
contrast frame: what you lack set beside what you have ("you have only a quote") - state what you have and what you must still do
contrast frame: a consequence turned against the claim ("so the bed still costs") - state the figure plainly
contrast frame: an absence ("you have no pool", "none is booked") - state what you have or what you must still do
uncommon word: "blurb" - name the thing ("the manager's description", "the profile text")
approximate number: write ~N and a spread as ±N, not "about N" (AGENTS.md core 8)
name the range itself ("¥11000 to ¥12500 a night"): "band" is trade jargon
two sentences run together ("service.Photography"): put a space after the period
